home_h3_6: Yigal Roytman represents private clients in home and property damage claims: water damage, dampness, blockages, wall peeling, capillary rise, floods, fire and weather damage — ensuring you receive the full compensation you deserve.
home_p_20: As a property appraiser representing the insured, Yigal Roytman specializes in professional documentation of home and property damage and representing private clients against insurance companies — so you receive the full compensation you deserve.
home_p_21: Insurance companies work with their own appraisers — and you're entitled to the same advantage. Yigal Roytman represents you exclusively, documents damage accurately and ensures claims are filed correctly, preventing unjustified reductions and securing fair compensation.
home_p_22: Water damage is among the most common insurance claims, often undervalued. Professional documentation of damage source, scope and restoration cost is key to proper compensation from the insurance company.
home_p_23: Chronic dampness and capillary rise constitute hidden damage that develops over time. An experienced appraiser knows how to locate the true cause, quantify hidden damage and prove to the insurance company the need for complete restoration.
home_p_24: Floods cause rapid and significant damage to floors, walls and furniture. Immediate and professional documentation of flood scope, including hidden damage beneath surfaces, is essential for a successful claim.
home_p_25: Fire and smoke damage extends far beyond what's visible. Comprehensive appraisal includes smoke, soot, heat and firefighting water damage — ensuring the insurance company covers the full restoration cost.
home_p_26: Storms, heavy rains and strong winds cause plaster peeling, cracks and facade damage. Accurate appraisal documentation links the meteorological event to damage and strengthens the insured's position in the claim.
home_p_27: As a property appraiser representing the insured, I accompany you through every stage — from the moment damage is discovered until you receive the compensation you deserve. An organized, transparent and professional process.
home_p_28: In the initial consultation, I listen to the damage description, examine your policy terms and clearly explain what your insurance coverage should include. This stage establishes the foundation for a solid claim.
home_p_29: I come to the property, thoroughly examine the damage — water damage, dampness, capillary rise, fire or any other damage — and document every detail in photographs and written findings. Accurate evidence is the basis for every successful claim.
home_p_30: Based on the inspection, I prepare a detailed appraisal report including damage value assessment, policy analysis and an organized claim document submitted to the insurance company — in professional language that speaks to their appraiser.
home_p_31: I stand by your side throughout the negotiation process with the insurance company, respond to their contradictory claims and ensure the compensation you receive reflects the actual damage. You're not alone against the company.
home_p_33: Private clients who contacted us after the insurance company offered partial compensation or denied the claim — and received much more.
home_p_34: Severe water damage in the living room and kitchen. The insurance company sent their appraiser and offered compensation that barely covered a third of the actual damage. Yigal came, documented everything professionally, and submitted a counter-opinion. In the end we received full and significantly higher compensation.
home_p_35: Severe wall dampness after heavy rains. I had no idea what I was entitled to or how to deal with the insurance company. Yigal patiently explained the entire process, represented me in an organized and professional manner, and in the end I received compensation that pleasantly surprised me.
home_p_36: After a partial apartment fire, the insurance company tried to minimize the recognized damage scope and exclude a large portion of damage from coverage. I contacted Yigal Roytman — a property appraiser representing the insured — who thoroughly examined the damage, prepared a detailed and reasoned opinion, and didn't give up on any item. The process with him was completely transparent and calm, and in the end we managed to receive compensation that reflects the actual damage. I warmly recommend to anyone who feels the insurance company isn't taking them seriously.
home_p_37: Before you sign an agreement with the insurance company — you deserve your own appraiser. As an experienced property appraiser, I accompany private clients throughout the entire process: from damage documentation, accurate assessment to receiving the fair compensation you deserve. I work alongside you — not alongside the insurance company.

about_h2_3: How a Professional Property Appraiser Works — From Field to Compensation
about_p_24: When the insurance company sends their appraiser, the insured remains alone against a professional and experienced system. Yigal Roytman provides a balancing solution: professional, documented and independent support throughout all claim stages — from filing the demand to receiving fair compensation.
about_p_25: As an independent property appraiser specializing in home and property damage, Yigal works exclusively for the private client's benefit. Treatment areas include water damage, dampness and capillary rise, blockages and wall peeling, floods, fire damage and weather damage. Every case is handled with the same systematic approach and precision that characterize a professional inspection report — because details determine compensation amount.
about_p_26: As a property appraiser representing the insured, I work exclusively for apartment owners — not for the insurance company. My clients are families and property owners who encountered unexpected damage: water damage, dampness, floods, fire and weather damage. When the insurance company sends their appraiser, I ensure your side is represented at the same professional level — and sometimes at a higher level.
about_p_27: Every water damage insurance claim begins with comprehensive property inspection — identifying damage source, complete scope documentation, and cross-referencing findings with policy terms. I submit an organized and reasoned appraisal opinion that makes it difficult for the insurance company to reduce compensation without justification. The experience I've gained handling capillary damage, blockages, wall peeling and more — enables me to identify damage that sometimes escapes insurance appraisers' eyes.
about_p_28: Dispute with an insurance company is a stressful experience — especially when the home is damaged and the offered compensation doesn't reflect reality. I take full responsibility for managing the entire appraisal process: property inspection, opinion preparation, negotiation with the insurance appraiser, and support until case closure. This way you can focus on property restoration, while the professional battle is in skilled hands.
about_p_29: Every damage case is handled with complete systematicity: meticulous inspection, accurate documentation, and clear presentation of findings — so you receive the full compensation you deserve.
about_p_30: Every property visit begins with systematic survey of every corner — identifying signs of dampness, capillary rise, fire and water damage that insurance companies tend to ignore. No details are skipped.
about_p_31: Every finding is documented in photographs, measurements and written detail. The appraisal opinion is built on solid evidence — leaving no room for arbitrary interpretation by the insurer.
about_p_32: Professional findings are presented to the client in simple and understandable language. You know exactly what was found, its value, and the next step — without ambiguity and without surprises.
about_p_33: As an appraiser representing the insured, works exclusively for your benefit — independent of the insurance company, without external pressure. The assessment is based solely on field reality and professional standards.
about_p_34: Accompanies the case throughout the entire process — from the moment the claim is filed until compensation is received. In case of a dispute with the insurance company, manages the negotiations with determination and professional knowledge.
about_p_35: As a property appraiser representing the insured, I bring to every case an organized and documented approach — exactly as required when dealing with insurance companies. The accumulated experience in handling apartment and property damage allows me to identify, document, and present the damage in a way that makes it difficult for the insurance company to reject or reduce the compensation.
about_p_36: Every claim is handled personally, with deep understanding of common damage patterns in residential apartments and the way insurance companies examine and evaluate the case.
about_p_37: Property appraiser — on the client's side, not on the insurance company's side.
about_p_38: Every property visit concludes with a detailed appraisal report including photographic documentation, professional findings description, and reasoned damage assessment. The report is written in clear language and serves as a central document with the insurance company — enabling negotiations based on facts, not assumptions.
about_p_39: Water damage, moisture, capillary rise, blockages, wall peeling, floods, fires, and weather damage — these are my areas of expertise. Familiarity with common damage patterns in residential apartments allows me to identify hidden damages that the insurance company's appraiser might overlook.
about_p_40: Experience in handling water damage and property insurance claims teaches how insurance companies examine cases, where they tend to reduce compensation, and how to present the case in a way that protects the insured's interests. This knowledge is a real advantage for my clients.
about_p_41: Private clients shouldn't have to understand insurance jargon. I explain every step of the process in simple language, update on case progress, and ensure the client understands their rights before any decision is made. Complete transparency throughout the entire process.
about_p_42: As a property appraiser representing the insured, I am committed to three principles that shape every case and accompany every client from the first moment until the successful closure of the claim.
about_p_43: I explain to every client exactly what they are entitled to, how the damage is calculated, and what can be claimed. No surprises, no cumbersome professional language — just a clear and accurate picture that allows you to make informed decisions throughout the entire process.
about_p_44: Insurance companies employ appraisers on their behalf — and you are entitled to the same expertise on your side. I act solely for your interest, ensuring that the compensation you receive will be fair and complete, not a compromise that is convenient for the insurance company.
about_p_45: Water damage, moisture, fire, and weather damage — every case requires meticulous documentation and attention to small details. I don't give up on a single detail, document every finding with precision, and persist with the insurance company until the claim is properly settled.

services_p_33: Property appraiser on behalf of the insured
services_p_34: When damage occurs to an apartment or property — water, moisture, fire, or weather — the insurance company arrives with their appraiser. Igal Roitman, an experienced property appraiser, works solely for your benefit: documents the damage as required, submits professional opinions, and ensures you receive fair and full compensation.
services_p_35: Every property damage requires accurate documentation and professional assessment. Without your own appraiser, the insurance company will determine the damage alone — and usually not in your favor. We represent you to ensure full and fair compensation.
services_p_36: Water damage is among the most common, but also the most difficult to document. Without assessment by a certified property appraiser, hidden damage in walls and infrastructure remains outside compensation. We ensure that all damage — visible and hidden — is included in the claim.
services_p_37: Chronic moisture and mold damage the apartment structure and residents' health. Insurance companies tend to minimize the scope of recognized damage. Your appraiser will examine thoroughly and document the full implications for a comprehensive claim.
services_p_38: Plumbing blockages cause comprehensive damage that extends beyond the point of failure. Without professional assessment, collateral damage to floors, walls, and infrastructure remains uncovered. We ensure the full scope is documented and submitted to insurance.
services_p_39: Peeling plaster and paint may indicate deeper structural damage. When a claim is filed only for visible damage, compensation is only partial. An experienced property appraiser will locate and document the source of the problem for full compensation.
services_p_40: Capillary rise is a complex phenomenon originating from the ground and spreading over years. Unprofessional documentation allows the insurance company to reject or minimize the claim. Your appraiser will provide a substantiated opinion that will withstand appeal.
services_p_41: Flooding creates immediate damage and hidden damage that is revealed after weeks. Without your water damage appraiser, hidden damage will not be included in the claim and you will bear the full restoration cost. We guarantee comprehensive documentation from the first moment.
services_p_42: Fire and smoke damage affects the property structure, electrical systems, furniture, and air quality. Unprofessional assessment misses extensive damage. An experienced property appraiser will conduct a comprehensive survey ensuring proper compensation for the entire scope of damage.
services_p_43: Storms, winds, and extreme rain events cause damage that insurance companies try to attribute to normal wear. Your property appraiser will prove the direct connection to the weather event and ensure you receive the compensation you deserve.
services_p_44: Not sure if your damage is covered? Contact us for initial consultation at no cost.
services_p_45: The insurance company arrives with their appraiser. You are entitled to the same expertise — only it will work for you. Independent representation by an experienced property appraiser is the difference between partial compensation and fair and full compensation.
services_p_46: The insurance company's appraiser is designed to protect their interests — not yours. Igal Roitman works solely on your behalf, examines the damage without compromise, and protects your rights against the insurance company throughout the entire process.
services_p_47: Water damage, moisture, capillary rise, wall peeling, floods, fire, and weather damage — every damage is documented systematically and professionally. Accurate documentation is the foundation of every successful claim, and we don't allow any item to slip from the list.
services_p_48: A professional opinion from an experienced property appraiser gives your claim real weight. We present the findings in a way that cannot be misinterpreted, and negotiate with the insurance company until you receive the compensation you deserve.
services_p_49: As a property appraiser on behalf of the insured, I accompany you through all stages of the claim — from the moment the damage was discovered until receiving proper compensation. Here are the four pillars of the professional work I perform for you.
services_p_50: I will come to the property, diagnose the damage thoroughly, and document it professionally — water damage, moisture, capillary rise, floods, fire, or weather damage. Accurate documentation is the foundation of every successful claim.
services_p_51: I will prepare a detailed and reasoned appraisal opinion, including damage value assessment, restoration cost breakdown, and professional substantiation for each item. The document will serve as your main weapon against the insurance company.
services_p_52: I will analyze the insurance company's compensation offer and identify gaps, shortcuts, and incorrect positions. If the insurer's appraiser improperly reduced compensation — I will know how to identify this and deal with them with data and professionalism.
services_p_53: I will be by your side at every stage — from filing the claim, through negotiations with the insurance company, to closing the case. You won't be left alone facing the bureaucracy; I handle all the details so you receive what you're entitled to.
services_p_54: Everything important to know before starting the insurance claim process
services_p_55: Immediately after discovering the damage — even before contacting the insurance company. A property appraiser on your behalf will properly document the damage, prevent evidence destruction, and ensure the claim is filed completely and substantiated. Early contact significantly increases the chances of receiving fair compensation.
services_p_56: Absolutely. Even if you've already opened a claim or received an initial compensation offer from the insurance company, an appraiser representing the insured can examine the offer, identify gaps, and conduct professional negotiations with them. It's not too late to act in your favor.
services_p_57: I specialize in handling water and moisture damage, blockages, wall peeling, capillary rise, floods, fire damage, and weather damage. Every damage is professionally documented and submitted to the insurance company with a detailed and substantiated appraisal report.
services_p_58: An appraiser representing the insurance company works for the company's benefit, not yours. A property appraiser representing the insured — like me — works solely for your benefit: independently examines the damage, protects your rights, and ensures the compensation you receive reflects the actual damage.
services_p_59: The fee is usually calculated as a percentage of the compensation amount achieved. This means I'm compensated only when you profit — which ensures my interest is identical to yours. In practice, the increased compensation achieved with an appraiser's assistance usually covers the service cost and beyond.
services_p_60: Assessing moisture damage requires professional examination of the damage source, its scope, and the required restoration cost. I'll use appropriate measuring tools, detailed photographic documentation, and sometimes expert opinions from additional professionals — to build a strong and proven claim file against the insurance company.
services_p_61: It's advisable to gather your insurance policy, all correspondence with the insurance company, and existing damage documentation (photos, invoices, reports). If you don't have documents — no problem. We'll start with a comprehensive damage survey and build the case together from the first stage.
services_p_62: The process duration depends on the damage complexity and the insurance company's responsiveness. Simple claims can be resolved within several weeks, while complex claims may take several months. Throughout the entire process, I accompany you step by step and update you on every development.
